newsitem.title: UK: LME copper creeps towards $2,200, others quiet.
newsitem.headline: LME copper creeps towards $2,200, others quiet.

text.p: Copper prices extended earlier gains in late inter-office trade on Thursday on the London Metal Exchange, with three month futures reaching a high of $2,190/95 a tonne by 1900 GMT from $2,167 at the afternoon kerb close.

Traders said continued light speculative buying and buy stops triggered above previous technical resistance at $2,175 fuelled the rally, which has taken copper to its highest level since early December.
Increasingly bullish chart patterns signalled a test of $2,215 resistance soon, some traders said.
A modest rise in stocks is expected on Friday and would not scupper the move higher, they added.
Other base metals showed more muted gains in reaction to copper's strength.
Aluminium moved to $1,562/64 from $1,555. A break above resistance at $1,570 would be seen as bullish.
